evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: ensuring our infrastructure meets regulatory and compliance obligations in a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant manner

evidence.domain_risk: Every year, we process hundreds of billions of events that have a financial impact on Checkout.com and our merchants... ensuring our infrastructure meets regulatory and compliance obligations
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Explicit financial-impact and regulatory/compliance language for a payments company's core financial data systems places this squarely in high domain risk.

evidence.testing_framing: Implement monitoring and alerting frameworks to ensure data pipeline performance and reliability
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Monitoring/alerting and data governance/security are framed as responsibilities the candidate implements directly, with ownership verbs, not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensuring our infrastructure meets regulatory and compliance obligations in a scalable, reliable and fault-tolerant manner
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Regulatory/compliance framing appears in the team description itself (not just a passing mention), combined with repeated data-integrity and accuracy language throughout, indicating a high risk register dominated by compliance and financial-trust concerns.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and build data pipelines to process data from our systems, services and applications... Continuously evaluate and implement new technologies to improve our platform and systems
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities mix new pipeline design/build with ongoing improvement and evaluation of existing systems at an already-scaled team.
